recommendation.explanationSummary: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside.

explanationBundle.whatThisPortfolioDoes: Long-only xStocks basket that keeps the onboarding lane simple while preserving concentrated mega-cap upside. It keeps 5% in AUSD as a yield buffer instead of forcing full equity exposure.
explanationBundle.howItIsBuilt: 95% stays in xStocks across 6 names. 5% remains in AUSD. Largest sleeves: NVDAx 18%, MSFTx 16.44%, AAPLx 15.75%. Starts from the pinned Mag 7 basket membership. Selects names from the starter basket only. Keeps the basket at 6 names.
explanationBundle.howItChanges: Rebalance only when drift clears 300 bps. Authoritative path-dependent scoring implies 3.3% annualized turnover, 12.07 bps annualized costs, and 1 rebalance over the frozen window. Legacy static proxy would have printed 95% turnover and 43.25 bps total costs with 5% parked in AUSD.
explanationBundle.whatWouldTriggerNextRebalance: A rebalance only becomes actionable when drift clears 3% and the lane is still allowed to activate under current route truth. The repo does not prove an autonomous scheduler today.
explanationBundle.howToReadReplay: After estimated costs, the pinned run delivered 23.42% versus 13.16% for basket.sp500_core_v1, an excess of +10.26%. Treat replay as validation, not a promise of future returns.
explanationBundle.bestFor: Best for someone who wants Mag 7 exposure through a curated xStocks basket with a visible 5% AUSD buffer and can accept moderate risk with roughly 18% in the largest name.

currentKnobs.label: Starter basket
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes basket membership before weights are assigned.

currentKnobs.label: Selection universe
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Widens the eligible pool beyond the starter basket without changing slot identity.

currentKnobs.label: Holdings breadth
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how many names survive ranking into the target basket.

currentKnobs.label: Starter anchor bias
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Keeps the slot anchored to its starter basket even when broader selection is enabled.

currentKnobs.label: Ranking signal
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes which names rise or fall inside the current basket.

currentKnobs.label: Weighting curve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how aggressively higher-ranked names dominate the basket.

currentKnobs.label: Signal power
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Makes the weighting curve flatter or more conviction-heavy without changing the underlying signal.

currentKnobs.label: Cash sleeve
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Changes how much capital stays in AUSD instead of xStocks exposure.

currentKnobs.label: Single-name cap
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Limits the maximum weight of one name.

currentKnobs.label: Rebalance trigger
currentKnobs.tuningImpact: Skips smaller drifts to reduce churn.
